high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website onmanorama.com. The content of the article discusses a person's journey and aspirations after completing their studies at a gurukula (a traditional Indian school). The individual mentions that others from his batch went into the priesthood because their families were traditionally involved in religious practices, but he took a different path. The text highlights that while he knows some basic rituals like Ganapathihomam and Thevaram, he emphasizes that Vedic study does not automatically make one a priest.
